method: Direct visual inspection of final CPU renders of actual exported Three geometry, preserved source drawings/photos and annotated comparisons.

views.name: front-isometric
views.findings: Complete exterior, four-pavilion massing, connected entry landing and native-scale bear; custom gold dome reads clearly.

views.name: rear-isometric
views.findings: Rear/side exterior is complete; no missing shell faces; inferred symmetry is documented.

views.name: front-elevation
views.findings: Source silhouette and custom ornament reviewed; crown and stages checked against native-level overlay.

views.name: roof-plan
views.findings: Full footprint, recesses, parapets, cupolas and roof terraces remain distinct and in frame.

views.name: structural-cutaway
views.findings: Actual slabs/walls exposed; rotunda remains open and rear circular stairs meet pavilion floor plates.

views.name: ground-floor
views.findings: First wall course exposes source-derived front rooms; unverified rear layout remains open.

views.name: stair-detail
views.findings: Circular treads and upper-floor apertures are visible; landings meet native floor tops. Review box is a deliberate cutaway.

views.name: entry-detail
views.findings: Raised landing joins arch, ordinary native leaves and approach stairs; native reference parts and bear provide scale.

comparisonSheets.findings: Same 12 px/m plan/elevation comparison. Source elevation uses the explicitly indicative same-sheet ruler; plan is source-aligned by mirroring model camera. Office labels fit and adaptations are stated.
Selected native levels line up with actual elevation; lower labels corrected for overlap. Cutaway and stair views show true slab holes and open rotunda.

limitations: CPU diffuse render; WebGL shaders, GPU memory and performance remain pending.
Geometry interiors are present; exact rear and upper room partitions are not documented.
No character traversal, collision, fire or collapse acceptance is claimed.
